messages:
alex: hey — super short notice, flight canceled. I can't make Sun 06:00–10:00 PT. Need someone to cover that window. Leaving quick handoff notes below, sorry for the late ping. :pray:

alex: handoff notes:
- prod-canary-1: healthy
- prod-canary-2: degraded (intermittent 5–15% 503s) — planned rolling restart at ~07:30 PT to pick up new image
- current open PRs: #421 (retry backoff), not required for this window
- risk: cache warmup after restart can cause 10–30s token-latency spikes; watch token latency and queue depth

alex: runbook snippet:
```
# restart canary deployment
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/prod-canary-2
# watch until pods are READY
watch -n5 'kubectl get pods -n inference | grep prod-canary-2'
# if pods stuck for >5m:
kubectl logs <pod-name> -n inference | tail -n 200
# rollback (if new image fails):
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/prod-canary-2
```

alex: full runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-basic

alex: can someone pick this up? I'll handoff before I head to the airport (leaving at 05:15 PT)

sam: I can take 06:00–08:00 PT. I'll monitor latency and the canary restart. I can escalate to maya if anything gets weird.

jordan: I can pick up 08:00–10:00 PT and finish the restart validation. sam — can you add me to the calendar event when you create it?

sam: added events to the rotation calendar and invited @jordan. oncall-bot: calendar event created for eng-oncall — Sun 06:00–08:00 PT (created by sam).

oncall-bot: reminder: please update the rotation doc with the explicit handoff notes.

maya: if latency spikes after restart, check redis connection pool and batching queue depth (queue length metric: inference.queue.len). If queue length > 500, reduce batch size to 16 and increase workers temporarily.

sam: noted. I'll set a short-lived alert: token_latency_p50 > 500ms for 5m -> pager. I'll mute noisy alerts and only alert on sustained spikes.

jordan: ack. I'll run the post-restart smoke: 100 concurrent requests @typical prompt; verify 95p token latency and error rate <1%. Will post results in this thread.

sam: also leaving this fallback in runbook: if rollout fails to reach ready, annotate and rollback:
```
kubectl -n inference annotate deploy/prod-canary-2 local-rollback=true && kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/prod-canary-2
```

alex: thanks everyone. @sam @jordan I'll DM the short-lived sudo creds and the pager routing info before 05:50 PT. Leaving final note: prioritize customer-facing routes; if necessary, divert traffic to prod-canary-1. :heart:

jordan: got it — will post handoff confirmation after 08:00 PT with smoke results. :thumbsup:

maya: I'll be on standby from 09:30–11:00 PT in case anything escalates after your shift. Good luck and safe travels. :wave:
